name: Pažaislis Monastery
scope: The standing church of the Visitation at Pažaislis Monastery and the directly connected north and south cloister ranges, with the immediate church steps and two attached quadrangles.
era: The standing restored Baroque exterior documented by the original 2007 photograph and 2017 heritage inventory.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla original, direct 2008 photographer release. Interior stucco, used for architectural context and omitted from the exterior model.

Exact Qualla engraving attributed to Napoleon Orda, independently matched to the Kaunas library impression and documented as the work of Józefa Kleczeńska after Orda in the 1880 Tygodnik Illustrowany. A historical anchor for the main dome, annex junctions and southern sacristy tower. The later standing Baroque front follows the exact modern photograph and heritage record.

Exact direct-camera 2007 photograph, signed by the named photographer in their first revision. The signed file record is simultaneous with the only original upload, the same account self-identifies as an original photographer in the other file it created, and the native structured record identifies an original creation by uploader. Model basis for the concave western elevation, tower openings, gold dials and principal dressed stonework.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla engraving and interior photograph. The surviving west elevation has an independently confirmed, firsthand public-domain photograph. The church plan and materials are supported by the national heritage survey.
